entry.name: icon
entry.label: The name of the icon to use for the compact representation (e.g. on a small panel).

entry.name: useCustomButtonImage
entry.label: Whether to use a custom image instead of an icon in the compact representation (e.g. on a small panel).

entry.name: customButtonImage
entry.label: The URL of the custom image to use instead of an icon in the compact representation (e.g. on a small panel).

entry.name: enableGreeting
entry.label: Enable the greeting.

entry.name: pinnedModel
entry.label: Main page: 0 favorites, 1 recent apps, 2 recent files

entry.name: defaultPage
entry.label: Default Page

entry.name: categoryNames
entry.label: Names of the All Apps pages, written by the launcher for the Default Page setting.

entry.name: customGreeting
entry.label: Custom greeting Text

entry.name: launcherPosition
entry.label: Where the launcher opens: 0 follow the launcher button (default), 1 horizontal center, 2 screen center, 3 panel edge.

entry.name: offsetX
entry.label: Deprecated: the launcher does not float away from the panel any more. Only kept so old configurations still load.

entry.name: offsetY
entry.label: Deprecated: the launcher does not float away from the panel any more. Only kept so old configurations still load.

entry.name: enableGlow
entry.label: Gives the launcher elements some glow.

entry.name: glowColor
entry.label: Color of the glow: 0 purple, 1 blue, 2 red, 3 customGlowColor

entry.name: customGlowColor
entry.label: Glow color used when glowColor is 3 (custom).

entry.name: compactListItems
entry.label: Show list items in a compact format

entry.name: showItemsInGrid
entry.label: Show list items in a compact format

entry.name: useExtraRunners
entry.label: Whether search uses only the KRunner plugins in extraRunners, instead of every plugin enabled in System Settings.

entry.name: extraRunners
entry.label: The plugin ids of the KRunner plugins to search with. Only used if useExtraRunners is true.

entry.name: appNameFormat
entry.label: How app names are shown: 0 name, 1 generic name, 2 name (generic name), 3 generic name (name).

entry.name: highlightNewlyInstalledApps
entry.label: Mark apps that were installed recently and not opened yet.

entry.name: systemFavorites
entry.label: Favorite ids of the system actions (lock-screen, logout, switch-user, suspend, hibernate, reboot, shutdown, save-session) shown as buttons next to the power menu.

entry.name: favorites
entry.label: List of favorites defined by the Plasma global theme layout script.

entry.name: favoriteApps
entry.label: Default favorite app ids used when the global theme does not define any.

entry.name: favoritesPortedToKAstats
entry.label: Whether the config-based favorites have been ported to KActivities stats already.

entry.name: useSystemFontSettings
entry.label: DEPRECATED: system font is now always used; kept only so old config files keep loading.

entry.name: appsIconSize
entry.label: Favorites apps icon size

entry.name: numberColumns
entry.label: Number of columns to favorites apps grid

entry.name: numberOfRows
entry.label: Number of rows to favorites apps grid
